sentence: One efficiency study pushes the point furthest: the baseline association between AI investment and efficiency is zero, and gains appear mainly where capable managers, sharper competitive pressure, stable institutional ownership and long-horizon financing come together
passage: [Kazakis (2026), abstract] "Using a labor-based measure of AI investment, the baseline results show no direct association between AI investment and firm efficiency. The heterogeneity analysis indicates that efficiency gains materialize primarily when firms pair AI with capable managers, face stronger competitive pressure, have more stable institutional investor ownership, and are able to secure long-term debt."

gemini.note: The sentence accurately paraphrases the empirical findings from the abstract regarding the baseline association and the specific factors driving efficiency gains.
